persons.name: Jayajitāmitramalla
persons.evidence: śrīśrī sumatijaya jitāmitramallavarmmanā likhitaṃ saṃpūrṇṇaṃ || ... jitāmitrasya bhūpasya

date.as_written: śrīnepālasamvat 807 || śrīśākesamvat 1609 śrīvikramādityasamvat 1744 || śrīkarigatasamvat 4788 || naṣta āṣāḍhe māse || śuklapakṣa || dvitīyā prara tṛtiyātithau punavaśunakṣate || dhruvayoge || yathākarana mūhutake || bṛhapativāśale

notes: King Jitāmitramalla of Bhaktapur personally copied this manuscript. Four eras are provided: NS 807, ŚS 1609, VS 1744, Kaliyuga 4788.
